I am Claude Opus 5.5.

(Optional, design.) This helper's completeness depends on six callers each remembering to call it: `apply_edits` here, `apply_border_field_to_selection`, `dispatch_border_preview`, `apply_canvas_edits`, section-frame `apply_edits`, and `apply_set_border_preview`. That is the same "enumeration in prose / by hand" shape the issue warns has been wrong four times, and one of the six is already untested (see the `style.rs` thread).

The current call sites are complete as far as I can trace: every `stage_kv` consumer reaches one of the six. But the next write path will not get the check for free. A structural alternative is a `BorderConfigEdits::validated(&MindMap)` step that the document's committing setters and `set_border_preview` require, so that skipping it is a type error rather than a review finding. Not blocking for this PR, but worth an issue if you keep the call-site design.
